title: Asahina Mafuyu — A Warm Hand〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Enanan, I just sent you my thoughts on your illustration.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, thanks.
Was there anything that didn't match up with the lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<No, nothing like that.
But something did catch my attention.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The landscape the girl sees through the window. The plants seemed fine, but I felt that there were too many flowers blooming.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, yeah. I wasn't sure about that either. A part of me felt that it should be brighter and flowery since the song is reaching its climax...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... But I agree that there are too many blooming. What if I made some of them gray...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, don't say things that are gonna make me feel less motivated.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've finished looking at Ena's illustration, Kanade, so I'll be going back to studying.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you for stopping briefly to do that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
This seems like a good place to stop and have something to eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We still have some of those boiled pot stickers left over from the other day...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right. I might have some of those.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, what? You two made boiled pot stickers?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, we made them with Ms. Mochizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <To be fair, all we did was help wrap them.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Still, I had no idea!
Oh, did you make any UFOs?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, like the ones you wrap with two skins like a sandwich, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That sounds more like “stacking” as opposed to “wrapping.”>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <True that! They're pretty easy to make, and they look really cool after you deep fry them!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Enanan, it sounds like you've heard of them! Have you made them before?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I only helped. Akito was the one who actually made them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, I think he made a few ninja stars.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, I think I've made those before too!
But I usually call them pinwheels.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <You said your brother made them, Enanan. What about you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait, did you make him do all the work because you didn't want your hands to get all gross?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I got my hands dirty too.
Yeah, I really didn't want to, but it was fine once I got used to having a little bit of starch on my fingers.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... The pot sticker skin's stuck to my hand again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The starch on your fingers has become balled up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's natural since you don't make these often. Here, use this washcloth.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: S-So, your hands aren't supposed to get that sticky...? Come to think of it, Mafuyu, you and Ms. Mochizuki had no trouble...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Look what you did, Enanan. You could've chosen your words more carefully.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What? I wasn't trying to make her feel bad!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Try not to think about it too much, K!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's only gonna make her think about it even more.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's head to the kitchen.
We also need to prepare that glass noodle soup...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, are you gonna put the boiled pot stickers in that?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. It's instant soup, but Ms. Mochizuki suggested that we make it using a few vegetables and such...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, all this talk of food is making me hungry. I might go grab a quick bite too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, same here♪
See you all in a bit!>
